title: Shooters World
specs: Largest indoor gun range in Florida with 74,000 square feet and 58 shooting lanes
Offers fully automatic firearms and high calibers up to .50 BMG
Children must be at least 7 years old to participate in Gun Safety for Kids course
Parent or guardian must stay with child during Gun Safety for Kids course
Must be at least 18 years old to shoot long guns; 21 to shoot handguns, full auto, or silencer
Must be 21 or older to attend Ladies-Only Introduction to Handguns course
Can accommodate up to 250 people for meetings, lunches, and dinners; up to three people per lane

blurb: Shooters World offers indoor shooting ranges with multiple lane lengths and a wide selection of firearms including handguns, rifles, shotguns, and fully automatic weapons. They provide firearm training classes for all levels, including ladies-only courses and gun safety for kids. Additional services include gunsmithing, firearm transfers, and event hosting with catering options.
extraNote: All Firearm Experiences must use ammunition purchased at Shooters World; ammunition and range time not included in experience price · Memberships are non-transferable and non-refundable · Shooters World reserves the right to refuse any gunsmith work deemed unsafe · Shooters World Orlando, 4850 Lawing Lane, Orlando, FL 32811
